name: How do professionals clean electronics and delicate items damaged by soot?

mainEntity.name: How do professionals clean electronics and delicate items damaged by soot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professionals use specialized techniques for cleaning electronics and delicate items to prevent further damage. This often involves careful hand cleaning with specific non-abrasive, anti-static, or pH-neutral cleaning solutions designed for electronics. For sensitive items like artwork, photographs, or collectibles, dry cleaning methods, specialized sponges, or even ultrasonic cleaning may be employed. The goal is to remove soot and neutralize corrosive residues without causing harm, often requiring a detailed assessment to determine the most appropriate restoration method for each item.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals clean electronics and delicate items with specialized hand cleaning, non-abrasive solutions, and techniques like dry or ultrasonic cleaning to remove soot without damage.
